title: Un-Straightening Generative AI: How Queer Artists Surface and Challenge the Normativity of Generative AI Models
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative workshop study that focuses on surfacing and challenging sociotechnical biases, specifically heteronormativity and hyper-positivity, in generative AI models. While it discusses social 'safety' standards and notions of 'decency,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or formal moral/ethical systems.
